QUOTE: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (line 566) calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` with its own functions, locking them if threading is enabled.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer only says "locking them if threading is enabled"; it doesn't state that a mutexed pair versus a plain pair is chosen at compile time (MBEDTLS_THREADING_C) inside the init function.
